Hardcore Servers, Doomhowl (NA), and Soulseeker (EU) are confirmed to remain at WoW Classic. Players can choose to transfer to PvE should they wish to continue on to The Burning Crusade Classic.

### PvP Server Balance
PvP server balance will be maintained to enforce a balance between Horde and Alliance, ensuring that neither side has the strength of numbers necessary to steamroll the other side. If the realm appears to be tipping out of balance, character creation for the larger side will be suspended until the numbers are brought back into parity. This was introduced in Season of Discovery and has been overwhelmingly popular.

### No GDKP Points Allowed

Within the NA and EU regions, GDKP (Gold Dragon Kill Points) will not be allowed on The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary.

## Phase Releases for The Burning Crusade Anniversary

The phase releases will be identical to those introduced both in the original Vanilla WoW and WoW Classic. Different zones, big mobs, and systems will be unveiled every few months during the run of the 20th Anniversary Edition.

## Enhance Your Gear with Epic Gems

Earn epic gems through mining in the Battle for Mount Hyjal with a Mining skill of 375, or discover them as rare drops within the Black Temple.

Looking to enhance your gear with epic gems? Purchase Jewelcrafting Designs from Indormi, Keeper of Ancient Gem Lore, inside the Battle for Mount Hyjal raid instance.

* * *

## Prove Your Worth in Arena Season 3

Arena Season 2 ends on August 18 (with weekly realm restarts). Prepare for a new season of competition as Arena Season 3 begins, bringing new rewards and the latest Arena gear available from vendors in Shattrath and Nagrand.
> **When** : September 1 (with weekly realm restarts)
> 
> 

At the end of Season 2, any remaining unspent Arena Points are converted to Honor Points (1 Arena Point = 10 Honor Points), and Arena Season 2 gear will be available from Area 52 vendors at a discount, with no Arena rating requirement. Arena Season 1 gear will also become available from Honor vendors in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar and the Champion’s Hall in Stormwind.

* * *

The Betrayer awaits. Rally your allies, steel your resolve, and prepare to face Illidan Stormrage within the Black Temple.

# **The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary – Full Roadmap & Phase Guide (2025–2026)**

World of Warcraft Classic celebrated its **20th Anniversary Edition** on **November 21, 2024** , launching fresh progression realms that begin in Classic and naturally advance toward **The Burning Crusade** . These realms are now preparing for the **Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary** , which will follow the original TBC content structure—modernized, improved, and progressively released over several phases.

Below is the complete roadmap, expected dates, feature breakdowns, and all major content updates coming to the **TBC Classic Anniversary** .

# **TBC Classic Anniversary Release Date**

Blizzard has not yet announced an official launch date, but based on current progression, the **expected release window falls between Winter 2025 and Spring 2026** .

The next milestone will be the **TBC Classic Anniversary Pre-Patch** , with the date still pending confirmation.
# **TBC Classic Anniversary Servers**

The TBC Anniversary progression will continue on the **existing 20th Anniversary Classic servers** , originally opened on **November 21, 2024** :

### **EU Realms**

* **Spineshatter** – PvP
* **Thunderstrike** – PvE

### **NA Realms**

* **Nightslayer** – PvP
* **Dreamscythe** – PvE

### **Oceanic**

* **Maladath** – PvP

Hardcore realms ( **Doomhowl – NA, Soulseeker – EU** ) remain strictly Classic servers, but players may transfer to PvE if they wish to advance into TBC.

# **Notable System Changes at Launch**

The Anniversary Edition includes a number of upgrades:

* **New reporting tools**
* **Guild dethroning feature**
* **Chronoboon Displacer (up to 10 stacks)**
* **Improved Honor Ranking system (Phase 2)**
* **Visual and performance upgrades**
* **Instant mail between characters on the same account**
* **No buff or debuff limits**
* **Dual Specialization added**

# **Faction Balance on PvP Servers**
To prevent faction dominance, **character creation will freeze temporarily** for the overrepresented faction until population stabilizes. This system was introduced during Season of Discovery and has been well-received.

# **GDKP Restrictions**

**GDKP runs are _not allowed_ in NA or EU** during the Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary.

This applies to all progression content.

# **Phase Overview – Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary (2025–2026)**

The Anniversary release will follow the proven structure of original TBC, with each phase unlocking new raids, zones, and systems.

Below is the full progression plan. All dates remain **TBD** until Blizzard confirms the rollout.

# **Phase 0 – Pre-Patch**

### **Highlights**

* **Blood Elves** (Horde)
* **Draenei** (Alliance)
* **Shaman for Alliance / Paladin for Horde**
* **Silvermoon City & The Exodar starter zones**
* **Mount training at earlier levels and reduced costs**
* **15% less XP required from 20–60**

## INTRODUCTION

World of Warcraft Classic quietly entered a new era in November 2024 with the launch of the 20th Anniversary realms. These servers were never meant to be static. They were built as living progression realms designed to move forward through WoW’s greatest eras — and now, in 2026, they reach their most important milestone: **The Burning Crusade.**

Unlike previous rereleases, TBC Classic Anniversary is a carefully curated long-term progression project. Blizzard is modernizing backend systems while preserving the authentic pacing, gearing, and social structure that defined early expansion gameplay.

...

Blizzard is evolving the original **20th Anniversary realms launched in November 2024** instead of opening new ones. This preserves community identity, guild progression, and server economies.

Hardcore realms **Doomhowl (NA)** and **Soulseeker (EU)** remain Vanilla-only, though characters can transfer to PvE realms to continue into TBC.

### PvP Balance & GDKP Restrictions

Faction balance enforcement will actively prevent population domination by either faction on PvP realms. Character creation will temporarily lock for the larger faction if imbalance occurs.

Additionally, **GDKP raids are prohibited** on NA and EU Anniversary realms, protecting progression integrity and preventing gold-based raid access.
